locale.description: The locale code to use for the UI, e.g., 'en_GB', 'es'. Corresponds to -l flag.

server_url.description: The default server URL for pump.io instances.

accounts.description: A list of account configurations to load into the client.

accounts_items.description: Schema for individual items in the 'accounts' list.

accounts_items_username.description: The username for the pump.io account.

accounts_items_server.description: The server URL for this specific account. If empty, uses the global ServerUrl.

dark_mode.description: Whether to enable dark mode in the Qt desktop client.

font_size.description: The default font size in points for the application UI.
